4Q26 Activity Report – Improved Operating Performance  
 
 
Anagenics Limited (ASX: AN1, “Anagenics” or the “Company”) today provides an update on 
activities during the quarter ended 30 June 2026 (“4Q26”). 
 
The Company's operational performance has continued to improve and expects to announce 
its maiden full year profit for FY26 subject to final audit.. 
 
During the fourth quarter of FY2026 (4Q26), the Company had Operating Cash Outflows of 
$0.08 million, and trading performance was positive for the period.   
 
The negative cash flow in 4Q26 was primarily driven by the resolution of outstanding creditor 
payments following the restructure. For the year ending on 30 June 2026 the Company 
experienced Operating Cash Outflows of $1.08 million, compared to the cash outflows of $1.6 
million for the year ending on 30 June 2025. 
  
The creditor payments catch-up is now complete, having reduced payables and borrowings 
from $2 million at 30 June 2025 to $0.2 million at 30 June 2026. 
 
The Company paid $40k in directors' fees in the quarter ending 30 June 2026. 
 
BLC Cosmetics has successfully restructured and is also exploring additional products to 
expand its portfolio. 
 
During 4Q26, royalty revenue from the YSB product line amounted to $446k, which is received 
in July 2026 (1Q27). The Company has invoiced for YSB Royalty revenue of $1.3 million for the 
year ending on 30 June 2026. 
 
 
The Board of Anagenics Limited authorised this announcement. 
 
For further information, please contact:  
 
Sandy Beard  
Chair, Anagenics Limited 
P: 0412 308 263 
E: sandy@xvgroup.com.au 
 
Anagenics is a health, beauty, and wellness business growing shareholder value through the global 
distribution and sales of its proprietary and licensed brands of differentiated, clinically validated anti-
aging solutions. BLC Cosmetics Pty Ltd is Anagenics’ wholly owned subsidiary focused on sales and 
distribution of leading Australian and international brands of cosmetic and wellness products.
